note: On a peninsula of St. Mary Reservoir ~5 km NW of Magrath, beach nearby; the outer sites on the north and west edge (A-02, A-03, A-05, A-06) sit just above the shore. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from the camping page (updated Aug 7, 2026) and the shop: 16 unserviced C$22, year-round (winter sites first come, services off), reservable May 15 - Sep 30 for A-01..A-10 and 011-016 first come; shop max 38-57 ft; no water, vault toilets. Pin moves ~130 m out of the reservoir onto the loop.
